name: harness-kit
description: Installs a provider-agnostic agentic development harness (personas, skills, rules, hooks, memory) into a project, adapted to that project. Ships one user-invoked installer skill and inert templates; registers no agents, hooks or commands globally.
suggestedPrompts: Run /harness-init to install harness-kit into this repository
Run /harness-init with Antigravity and Claude Code adapters
Inspect what harness-kit would detect in the current repository
